feeds.title: Project Soulmate Blog
feeds.description: We are Manhattan matchmakers that are experienced and knowledgeable at being the perfect Matchmaking in New York City. Project Soulmate is about exposing people to ideas, to other people, and even sometimes to a new way of thinking about love and dating.

feeds.title: The New York Times » Dating and Courtship
feeds.description: News about Dating and Courtship, including commentary and archival articles published in The New York Times. The New York Times is dedicated to helping people understand the world through on-the-ground, expert and deeply reported independent journalism.

feeds.title: Love in 90 Days Blog
feeds.description: In the Love In 90 Days blog, best-selling author Dr. Diana Kirschner serves up her best dating tips & relationship advice for women (& courageous men). At least five times a month, you will see her latest and most powerful hacks on dating, relationships, commitment, self-confidence and on cultivating inner peace no matter what.

feeds.title: Dateology Coach Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest Dateology Coach advice and answers on dating, advice, dating after trauma and more! My name is Christan Marashio. After 10 years of writing the internationally-read dating advice column And That's Why You're Single, I decided to switch gears. In addition to coaching, my goal is to educate people on not just traditional theories but the science behind them.

feeds.title: A Cup of Jo » Relationships
feeds.description: Explore thoughts, questions and advice on marriage, dating, relationships and more! Founded in January 2007, Cup of Jo is a daily women's lifestyle site that covers style, culture, food, travel, relationships and parenting. Known industry-wide for its large and deeply engaged readership.

feeds.title: The Relationship Suite Blog
feeds.description: If you are struggling in your relationship, the blogs from The Relationship Suite will help you deal with your issues & emotions. We are here to help you begin the healing process. We work with individuals and couples in New York and New Jersey, helping them communicate more effectively, develop and deepen intimacy, and achieve fulfillment in their relationships.

feeds.title: NYCDateNite Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Alexis and the NYCDateNite is a blog that brings you gifting advice and NYC dating information and guide. Dating can be a treacherous road, potentially leaving a girl pretty frustrated. On the other hand, dating can also be an amazing time, that is, of course, if you know exactly where to go and what to do. That's why I launched NYCDateNite.

feeds.title: Melani Robinson Blog
feeds.description: My name is Melani Robinson and I'm a writer/blogger, and online dating expert living in New York City on the Upper West Side. It is my hope that I can always keep you entertained, laughing, and coming back for more.
